items.custom1_q: How do I place an order for a Custom Case?
items.custom1_a: Select a Custom Case product in the catalog, click 'Custom Now', upload your favorite image, adjust the photo position, and proceed through checkout until payment is complete.
items.custom2_q: How long does the production process (Pre-Order) take?
items.custom2_a: HD printing and Quality Control take 3-7 business days depending on the order queue.
items.custom3_a: We support over 500+ phone models from brands like iPhone, Samsung, Xiaomi, Poco, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, and Infinix. If your model isn't listed, contact our Customer Service.
items.shipping1_q: When will my order be shipped?
items.shipping1_a: Orders will be shipped immediately once pre-order production is completed (3-7 business days) via the courier service chosen during checkout.
items.shipping2_q: How much is the shipping cost?
items.shipping2_a: Shipping costs are automatically calculated based on the destination address and selected courier at checkout.
items.shipping3_q: Do you offer international / overseas shipping?
items.shipping3_a: Currently we ship across all regions in Indonesia. For overseas shipments, please contact our Customer Service first.
items.warranty1_q: Is there a warranty if the received case is the wrong model or damaged?
items.warranty1_a: Yes! We provide a 100% Return or Free Reprint Warranty if there are printing/model errors on our part or physical damage during delivery.
items.warranty2_q: How do I claim a warranty?
items.warranty2_a: Send an uncut unboxing video and photos of the received item to our WhatsApp Customer Service within 2x24 hours after delivery.
items.payment1_a: We accept Bank Transfer (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI), QRIS, E-Wallets (ShopeePay, Dana, OVO, GoPay), as well as Indomaret & Alfamart.
